title: Exemption for Units Sharing Kitchen or Bath with Landlord
requirement: Rental units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord resided at the property prior to the tenants.
coverage_conditions: rental units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord
exemptions: landlord resided at the property prior to the tenants
quoted_span: Where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord, the unit will be exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.

title: Minimum Rental Debt Threshold for Nonpayment Eviction
requirement: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is prohibited unless the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month's Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area.
coverage_conditions: fully or partially covered rental units
quoted_span: Eviction for nonpayment of rent is no longer allowed for rental debt less than one month of the Fair Market Rent for the unit

title: Elimination of Lease Non-Renewal Eviction for Substantially Similar Leases
requirement: Landlords are prohibited from evicting tenants for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon the expiration of a fixed-term lease.
coverage_conditions: fully or partially covered rental units
quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

title: Material Lease Violation Eviction Requirements
requirement: Material lease violations must involve mutually agreed terms, cause substantial actual damage to the landlord, and stem from unreasonable tenant behavior, accompanied by a detailed notice to stop.
coverage_conditions: fully or partially covered rental units
quoted_span: Material lease terms only include mutually agreed upon lease terms.

title: Annual General Adjustment Cap
requirement: The Annual General Adjustment (AGA) that landlords may apply to raise rent each year is capped at a maximum of 5%.
